Step Number: 9  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in logic when comparing the birth years of the directors. The Planner incorrectly concluded that Don Hahn (born in 1955) was born earlier than Fernando di Leo (born in 1932) based on an irrelevant comparison of their ages at the time their respective films were released. This misinterpretation of the task led to the wrong answer. The task required a direct comparison of birth years, not ages at the time of film releases.
